info.title: Arena API
info.description:
The Arena API is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway that provides unified access to models from multiple providers.

## Quickstart

1. **Sign up** at [arena.ai](https://arena.ai) and open the Arena API dashboard.
2. **Create a virtual API key** on the [Keys page](https://portal.api.preview.arena.ai/dashboard/keys).
3. **List available models**:
   ```bash
   curl https://api.preview.arena.ai/v1/models \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARENA_KEY"
   ```
4. **Make your first completion**:
   ```bash
   curl https://api.preview.arena.ai/v1/chat/completions \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARENA_KEY" \
     -d '{"model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}'
   ```
5. **Use Claude Code** by pointing Anthropic-compatible clients at the Arena API root URL:
   ```bash
   export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.preview.arena.ai
   export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=$ARENA_KEY
   export ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-6
   export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-6
   export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
   export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=claude-opus-4-6
   claude --model "$ANTHROPIC_MODEL"
   ```
## Authentication

Authenticate requests with a virtual API key in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-arena-key>
```

`/anthropic/v1/messages` is a compatibility alias for `/v1/messages`; new Anthropic SDK and Claude Code integrations should use the Arena API root URL with `/v1/messages`.

Anthropic-compatible `/v1/messages` requests may authenticate with either header:

```
x-api-key: <your-arena-key>
Authorization: Bearer <your-arena-key>
```

## Model Fallback

When a model fails with a provider-side error (429, 5xx, or a transport failure), the gateway can try backup models before giving up.

- Pass an ordered `fallbacks` array alongside `model` to name backups.
- Narrow the trigger statuses with `fallback_on` (a subset of 429/500/502/503/504).
- Every field has an `X-Arena-*` header equivalent (`X-Arena-Fallbacks`, `X-Arena-Fallback-On`, `X-Arena-Allow-Fallbacks`) for clients that can only set headers.
- Responses carry `X-Arena-Fallback-Index` / `X-Arena-Fallback-Reason` when a fallback fired; if every model fails, the error body includes an `arena_fallback_attempts` list.

```bash
curl https://api.preview.arena.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARENA_KEY" \
  -d '{"model": "claude-opus-4-6", "fallbacks": ["gpt-5.5", "claude-sonnet-4-6"], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}'
```

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. This field takes precedence over `max_tokens` when both are supplied.

stream.description: If true, the response streams as server-sent events (SSE) in the `text/event-stream` format.

tools.description: List of tools (functions) the model can call.

fallbacks.description: Ordered list of backup models to try when the primary model fails with a provider-side error (429, 5xx, or a transport failure). The gateway tries them in order after the primary model's own retries are exhausted, and bills only the model that succeeds. Capped at 3 entries. May also be sent as the `X-Arena-Fallbacks` header (comma-separated) for clients that cannot set request-body fields.

fallback_on.description: Optional subset of the default trigger statuses (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) that should trigger a fallback. May only narrow the default set, never widen it. Header equivalent: `X-Arena-Fallback-On`.

allow_fallbacks.description: Set to false to opt a routing-mode request out of automatic fallback. Header equivalent: `X-Arena-Allow-Fallbacks`.

model.description: The actual OpenAI-backed model that handled the request. Routing may differ from the requested model.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint provided by the **Arena API**.

Pass a model name (e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-6`) to send the request to that model.

Streaming is supported — set `stream: true` to receive server-sent events.

Pass an optional `fallbacks` array of backup models to try when the primary model fails with a provider-side error (429, 5xx, transport). See `X-Arena-Fallback-Index` / `X-Arena-Fallback-Reason` in the response.

200.description: Chat completion response. When `stream: true`, the response is `text/event-stream` with `data: {...}` chunks terminated by `data: [DONE]`.

X-Arena-Fallback-Index.description: 1-based position of the fallback model that served the response (1 = first fallback, 2 = second, …). Present only when a fallback served the request; absent when the primary model served it.

X-Arena-Fallback-Reason.description: The upstream status (or "transport_error") that knocked out the model tried just before the one that served. Present only when a fallback fired.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible Responses API endpoint provided by the **Arena Gateway**.

This route is intended for OpenAI SDK clients and tools such as Codex that use `/v1/responses`. The gateway preserves Responses-specific fields such as `previous_response_id`, `prompt_cache_key`, `reasoning`, and tool payloads while routing, billing, logging, and rate-limiting the request. Routing aliases are allowed but are constrained to OpenAI-backed models on this endpoint.

Streaming is supported — set `stream: true` to receive Responses API server-sent events.

200.description: Responses API response. When `stream: true`, the response is `text/event-stream` with Responses event chunks.

schema.description: Responses server-sent event stream with `event:` and `data:` lines.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible Responses compaction endpoint provided by the **Arena Gateway**.

This route supports Codex and other Responses API clients that call `/v1/responses/compact` to produce opaque compaction items for later Responses calls. The gateway proxies compact requests directly to OpenAI, preserves forward-compatible request fields and Codex tracing headers, bills token usage, and constrains routing aliases to OpenAI-backed models.

200.description: Responses compaction result containing opaque compaction output items.

post.description:
Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint provided by the **Arena API**.

This route is intended for Claude Code and Anthropic SDK clients. Set the client base URL to the Arena API root URL and pass your Arena API key as the Anthropic API key. The gateway accepts `x-api-key: <your-arena-key>` on this route and forwards the request to Claude through the gateway billing, logging, and rate-limit pipeline.

Streaming is supported — set `stream: true` to receive Anthropic server-sent events.

200.description: Anthropic Messages response. When `stream: true`, the response is `text/event-stream` with Anthropic event chunks.

get.description:
Returns the list of models available through the Arena API.

Model entries have `type: "model"` with pricing, latency, and architecture details.
Returns `200 OK` when the Arena API is running. No authentication required.
